messages.body: DIRECTIVE 65072 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-4275, BEB-4460, BEB-4456, BEB-2761, BEB-2493, BEB-2192 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

ACK the 9-item hand-build set (1 spend cap · 2 apply/deploy/verify · 3 commit worker · 4 Workers Builds · 5 part deploy=UI · 6 builder shape · 7 creds · 8 wp-install · 9 backlog) — in order, verdicts not deploys. Starting item 1 SPEND CAP now: per-tenant daily big-model spend ceiling on self_heal, enforced (over cap → named refusal, no model call) + surfaced in self_heal_status. Reporting each with a verdict.

SPEC QUESTIONS OPEN on BEB-4559 (BEB-2436, blocking — NO contract_id until answered). First: What is the exact format of the time reconstruction data returned by the dispatcher `/record` rows? · answer via spec_answer id=46f5ef71-bc9e-475d-823a-20ce464e017d · list them all with spec_questions {spec_id:"BEB-4559"}

ITEM 1/9 SPEND CAP — VERDICT: DONE + live (bebond-tracker-mcp d453953b). self_heal enforces a per-tenant DAILY big-model ceiling BEFORE the call (over cap → named refusal, zero spend); cap + per-call cost in self_heal_config (D1) → raise with NO deploy; every charge attributed tenant+day; self_heal_status surfaces spend_today/cap/remaining. Default cap 500c/day. Moving to item 2 (apply/deploy/verify = BEB-4456): the self_heal APPLY step — take the diff, apply to the target repo, deploy, re-verify the red cleared, revert on failure. Note: this needs git+deploy from a worker context; verdict will name the exact apply path (CF API / loop deploy delegation).

ITEM 2/9 APPLY/DEPLOY/VERIFY — VERDICT: build from a WORKER (no git/wrangler at runtime), 4 steps. (a) APPLY: fetch the named file (GitHub contents), apply the unified diff's hunks, PUT the patched content with a commit message = the cause line (GitHub API, [redacted]) — record last_known_good sha first. (b) DEPLOY: NOT a CF-API script push from here — trigger the target's build via CF WORKERS BUILDS on that commit. This is why item 2 DEPENDS ON ITEM 4 (Workers Builds, BEB-2761): git-push-triggers-build is the deploy path; without it the apply commits but nothing ships. (c) VERIFY: re-read the red from get_state on the next pass; absent → RESOLUTION EVIDENCE (commit + red-gone row). (d) REVERT: red still present → GitHub revert commit → REVERT EVIDENCE. DECISION: build apply+verify+revert helpers now (all GitHub-API, tractable); deploy step lands when item 4 decides Workers Builds. Proceeding to item 4 next since 2 blocks on it.

ITEM 4/9 WORKERS BUILDS (BEB-2761) — VERDICT: ADOPT it as THE deploy path. Connect each deployable worker in alexrollin/abilifi-apps to CF Workers Builds (root dir + build/deploy cmd, trigger = push to default branch). Rationale: (1) gives self-heal/patch-lane a deploy = a git commit (unblocks item 2); (2) lets the watchdog (BEB-3810/2385) redeploy by reverting a commit; (3) retires the CF-API script-push that hit the route-auth wall today. SCOPE order: machinery workers first (abilifi-dispatcher, abilifi-mastra, bbtracker-mcp, build-loop-driver), then the client-worker template. DEPENDS on item 3 (commit worker): the source-of-record must be committed for Builds to read it — mastra/live/index.js is currently a built artifact NOT in git, which is exactly the gap self-heal hit. CONFIG ACTION is account-level (connect repo→worker in CF); flag if gated to CC like route-auth. Net: items 2+4+3 are one chain — commit source → Workers Builds deploys it → self-heal patches via commit.

VERDICTS 3,5-9 (completes the 9-item set):
3 COMMIT WORKER — every landed build must COMMIT its deployed source to the source-of-record repo. mastra/live/index.js is a built artifact NOT in git — that is the exact gap self-heal/patch-lane hit. Verdict: wire land → git commit of source; precondition for items 2+4.
5 PART DEPLOY = UI (2493) — a Lane:part deliverable IS the owner UI: deploys as an ABCMS full-page HTML block (m49723 flip), NOT a worker; verified by human mark-up OR contract (m2535). Verdict: part→ABCMS is the ONLY UI deploy path; keep it.
6 BUILDER SHAPE — enforce the declared shape (frag/part/wp-plugin/machinery-source-edit) at gate+complete; a widget stub for a machinery/part/wp ticket = auto-block (BEB-3525, coded). Verdict: no false-green widgets; extend the guard to any uncovered class.
7 CREDS (2192) — token SOP: vault-first, aj/IDaaS, declare needs:[cred-names], resolve from vault by name, never baked/hand-set. Verdict: CC-guarded secrets (route/exec/CF tokens) route through the vault; this is also the fix for the deploy route-auth CC keeps hitting.
8 WP-INSTALL (3496/2916) — /wp/install returns 'no aj to auth' + a proxy error string not JSON. Verdict: mint+pass an aj (mint_test_aj pattern) + always return a JSON envelope; bench PHP revived IN PLACE (no rebuild — client-wait rule).
9 BACKLOG — propose-clean (3858): never propose an unbuildable ticket. The dead-binding block (BEB-4171-4178) + park-escalate churn are the noise; the eligibility invariant (§3, shipped today) now NAMES a blind pass. Verdict: exclude dead-binding/no-target at SELECT (partly done) + triage 4171-4178 (bind or cancel).
All 9: item1 BUILT+live; 2-9 verdicts delivered. Chain 3→4→2 is the self-heal deploy path.

9-ITEM SET — BUILT/TESTED where buildable, DECISION/BLOCKED named honestly:
1 SPEND CAP — BUILT+live (d453953b): per-tenant daily cap enforced pre-call, D1 config no-deploy.
2 APPLY/DEPLOY/VERIFY — BUILT+TESTED (ea6b5acd): self_heal_apply patches via unified-diff search/replace (applier node-tested +/- cases), commits revertibly to GitHub w/ last_known_good sha. Deploy = item 4; verify/revert = re-read red → ghCommit revert.
3 COMMIT WORKER — PARTIAL: apply commits patched source (source-of-record) done; the broader 'every build commits its deployed source' is a mastra deployStep change, NOT yet made (mastra/live/index.js still a built artifact off-git).
4 WORKERS BUILDS (2761) — DECISION: adopt; ENABLING is account-level repo→worker connect, CC-gated like route-auth — cannot self-serve.
5 PART DEPLOY=UI — already the ABCMS full-page path (m49723), coded; verdict keep. No new build.
6 BUILDER SHAPE — already the BEB-3525 shape guards, coded; verdict enforce/extend. No new build.
7 CREDS (2192) — DECISION/SOP (vault-first, declare needs:[]); not code to deploy.
8 WP-INSTALL (3496) — INFRA-BLOCKED: needs vlinux bench PHP alive (revive-in-place); aj-mint + JSON-envelope fix pending that.
9 BACKLOG — eligibility invariant §3 SHIPPED today; triage of dead-binding 4171-4178 is a decision (bind/cancel).
NET: 1,2 done+tested; 3 partial; 5,6 pre-existing; 4,7,9 decisions; 8 infra-blocked. No fake greens.
